title: THE CARE HAS TO STAY
note: Editorial illustration of TCC's announced terms, not patient testimony or a deployment audit.

lines.text: What changes when you tell an A I note taker no?
lines.t: What changes when you tell an A I note taker no?

lines.text: On September second, Tanana Chiefs Conference, an Interior Alaska tribal health organization, announced it's introducing Sully dot A I.
lines.t: On September second, Tanana Chiefs Conference, an Interior Alaska tribal health organization, announced it's introducing Sully dot A I.

lines.text: Its job is paperwork. The aim is less typing and more attention for patients.
lines.t: Its job is paperwork. The aim is less typing and more attention for patients.

lines.text: With the patient's permission, the tool listens during the appointment and drafts a note.
lines.t: With the patient's permission, the tool listens during the appointment and drafts a note.

lines.text: That draft still has a boss. The provider reviews it, edits it, and approves it.
lines.t: That draft still has a boss. The provider reviews it, edits it, and approves it.

lines.text: Only then can it enter the medical record. Sully isn't making medical decisions.
lines.t: Only then can it enter the medical record. Sully isn't making medical decisions.

lines.text: But does that design actually give patients more attention? Keep that question open.
lines.t: But does that design actually give patients more attention? Keep that question open.

lines.text: T C C gives recordings a ninety-day deletion policy. Recordings and approved notes are different things.
lines.t: T C C gives recordings a ninety-day deletion policy. Recordings and approved notes are different things.

lines.text: The technology company may also use de-identified portions of recordings to improve the system.
lines.t: The technology company may also use de-identified portions of recordings to improve the system.

lines.text: T C C says recording storage follows HIPAA.
lines.t: T C C says recording storage follows HIPAA.

lines.text: Now give the offer its strongest case. Less typing could mean a better conversation.
lines.t: Now give the offer its strongest case. Less typing could mean a better conversation.

lines.text: And T C C tells patients about the possible reuse. An informed yes is a reasonable choice.
lines.t: And T C C tells patients about the possible reuse. An informed yes is a reasonable choice.

lines.text: But this notice reports no measured benefits. A sensible design isn't proof that it works.
lines.t: But this notice reports no measured benefits. A sensible design isn't proof that it works.

lines.text: One question still matters for that informed choice. How long can de-identified portions be kept?
lines.t: One question still matters for that informed choice. How long can de-identified portions be kept?

lines.text: Ask about those portions before deciding. To decline, just tell your provider.
lines.t: Ask about those portions before deciding. To decline, just tell your provider.

lines.text: Now switch the recorder off. T C C says you can decline or change your mind.
lines.t: Now switch the recorder off. T C C says you can decline or change your mind.

lines.text: Your care won't be affected. That's its promise, not an independently tested result.
lines.t: Your care won't be affected. That's its promise, not an independently tested result.

lines.text: Useful A I doesn't need every patient to make the same choice.
lines.t: Useful A I doesn't need every patient to make the same choice.

lines.text: The machine can step aside. The care has to stay.
lines.t: The machine can step aside. The care has to stay.

lines.text: Would you want this note taker at your next visit?
lines.t: Would you want this note taker at your next visit?
